description: This file is a script for analyzing TypeScript source files within a project to detect certain architecture smells or issues, such as extension facades, runtime type references, and service locator patterns. It imports various utility modules for file system navigation, TypeScript AST analysis, and inventory collection, and provides functionality to scan specific source directories, process AST nodes, and output findings in human-readable or JSON format.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries for sorting based on category, file, line, kind, specifier, and reason.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to the list of architecture smell entries.

methods.name: scanPluginSdkExtensionFacadeSmells
methods.description: Scans a source file for re-exports related to plugin SDK extension facades, indicating potential architecture issues.

methods.name: scanRuntimeTypeImplementationSmells
methods.description: Detects direct references to runtime implementation shim files within runtime type declaration files.

methods.name: scanRuntimeServiceLocatorSmells
methods.description: Analyzes source files for patterns involving global mutable state and runtime store creation indicating service locator usage.

methods.name: collectArchitectureSmells
methods.description: Collects all detected architecture smell entries across relevant project files.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the collected architecture smell inventory into a human-readable string.

methods.name: runArchitectureSmellsCheck
methods.description: Main function to run the architecture smell analysis, outputting results in JSON or human-readable format.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initiates the architecture smell check.
